snippet.title: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers - Official Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom latam
snippet.description:
Watch the latest gameplay trailer for WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers exclusively revealed in our FGS Live From gamescom latam show. WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers is a Soulslike, action-RPG set in the dark and tumultuous late Ming Dynasty. Launching July 24, 2025 on Xbox Series X|S, Windows, day one on Game Pass, PlayStation 5, EPIC Games Store, and Steam.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #wuchangfallenfeathers #gamescomlatam
